guides.favoredWhen: Annoying range, but after Voltaic you are usually the kill. Buffer stun, watch flash.

keyTips.text: Your range annoys him: he survives early, so punish before Voltaic.
His Voltaic spike flips it: end it before the item.
He buffers your stun on pop-out: hold Q until he lands.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: His Mercs rush: tenacity covers one stun, so chain.
He pokes and backs off: hold stun for his commit.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
He watches your flash: burn his attention, engage when sums are down.
Flash burned plus stun held: the Zed whose R never lands never kills.

keyTips.text: Accept a weak early phase into most lanes and farm for scaling over repeated mana-heavy trades.
Treat level 6 as the first clear spike, with a loaded stun plus Tibbers threatening kills and ganks.
Save Flash for high-value objective and teamfight engages instead of low-impact chases.

tips.text: Keep the Pyromania stun ready to punish a spent enemy cooldown, stop an all-in, or set up the jungler.
Throw autos when the opponent mispositions, but respect mid gank angles and ward from a safe spot.
Play the level-10 spike when max-rank W gives enough priority to move first.
Slow-push ahead of a dive, recall, long roam, or safer lane; freeze to deny farm or hold the wave closer when behind.
Fast-push when priority matters for a dragon fight, a roam, a quick recall, or pinning the opponent under turret.
Use a neutral handshake wave on a centered cannon wave for a safer recall or roam.
Refuse forced roams by weighing lost minions, unspent gold, and target danger before leaving.
Take longer roams after a cannon wave starts pushing out or a crash strands many allied minions under the enemy turret.
After pushing, convert the free time into vision, a roam, an efficient recall, or a jungler play instead of idling.
Turn level-6 stun and Tibbers picks directly into objective pressure.
Claim priority with W waveclear, then rotate only when the wave state keeps the move cheap.
Protect farm and levels early, then open picks and mid priority at the level-6 and level-10 windows.
Drop the loaded stun and Tibbers onto a carry or a cluster, then turn the pick into objective pressure.

itemization.text: Run First Strike with Cash Back, Triple Tonic, Cosmic Insight, Bone Plating, and Overgrowth.
Build Rod of Ages into Crimson Lucidity, Archangel's Staff, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Liandry's Torment, and Bloodletter's Curse.
Start Dark Seal, Refillable Potion, and Stealth Ward, then buy Tear of the Goddess, Catalyst of Aeons, and Blasting Wand early.
